resources.string:
Welcome to WipeOut!

This app protects your phone if it gets lost.

A unique secret code has been generated for you. Save it somewhere safe (a notebook or password manager). If your phone is lost, send an SMS containing this exact code to your own phone number and WipeOut will immediately lock the screen.
⚠️ Save this code NOW. You will need it to remotely lock your phone if it is lost or stolen.
Please complete both setup steps before finishing.
WipeOut needs Device Administrator access so it can lock your screen the moment your secret code arrives by SMS.
Device administrator disabled. Remote locking will not work until you re-activate it.
Device administrator permission was not granted. Remote locking will not work.
Some permissions were denied. The app may not work correctly.
✅ Protection Active – your phone is secured

Your secret code is:

%1$s

To remotely lock this phone, send an SMS containing this code to your own phone number from any other device.
This will create a new secret code. Your old code will stop working immediately. Make sure to save the new code.
A lock request was received but Device Administrator is not active. Please re-enable WipeOut\'s device-admin permission.
Airplane mode was turned on. While it is active, SMS-based remote locking is unavailable. Disable airplane mode to restore protection.
